# Project Reference {.unnumbered}

Quick reference for all projects covered in this history.

| Project | Campus | Year | Era | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ARPANET / TCP/IP design | UCLA | 1969 | The Internet Itself | Packet switching, Node 1, RFCs, TCP/IP, DNS |
| ARPANET Node 3 | UC Santa Barbara | 1969 | The Internet Itself | Culler and Fried; 3 of 4 original nodes were UC |
| BSD TCP/IP stack | UC Berkeley | 1983 | The Internet Itself | Implementation that spread TCP/IP universally |
| BSD Unix | UC Berkeley | 1970s-80s | Foundations | Licensing model for open source |
| INGRES / PostgreSQL | UC Berkeley | 1973 / 1986 | Foundations | World's most popular independent database |
| tz database | UCLA (Paul Eggert) | 1986 | Universal Infrastructure | Every OS clock on earth |
| Apache HTTP Server | UCB (Behlendorf) | 1995 | Universal Infrastructure | Powered >50% of global web |
| UCSC Genome Browser | UC Santa Cruz | 2000 | Open Science | Reference for genomic research worldwide |
| EEGLAB | UC San Diego | 1997-2001 | Open Science | 14,400+ citations, 350K+ downloads |
| Cytoscape | UC San Diego | 2003 | Open Science | 300K downloads/yr, network biology standard |
| Jupyter | UC Berkeley | 2001-2014 | Scientific Computing | Dominant interface for interactive computing |
| Apache Spark | UC Berkeley | 2009 | Scientific Computing | Databricks $62B+; core data engineering |
| Ceph | UC Santa Cruz | 2004 | Infrastructure at Scale | Exabyte storage; funded CROSS/first UC OSPO |
| RISC-V | UC Berkeley | 2010 | Infrastructure at Scale | 10B+ devices, 350+ orgs, 70 countries |
| Named Data Networking | UCLA | 2010 | Infrastructure at Scale | Future internet architecture research |
| Ray | UC Berkeley | 2016 | Infrastructure at Scale | Core OpenAI compute infrastructure |
